overview: The commission approved multiple one-day liquor licenses for community events and seasonal sports and authorized a restaurant license transfer. The body also granted conditional approval for a new all-alcohol license for the Great American Beer Hall development.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the February 9 special meeting and the February 15 regular meeting.

items.title: One-Day License Approvals
items.summary: Approved one-day licenses for the West Medford Community Center, Tufts College, the Friends of the Public Library, and St. Raphael Parish. The commission also authorized six one-day licenses for Boston Glory home games at Hormel Stadium between May and July.

items.title: New License: Deep Cuts LLC
items.summary: Approved a new liquor license for the establishment at 21 Main Street, subject to the final signature for an entertainment license.

items.title: License Transfer: Bocelli's Restaurant
items.summary: Approved the transfer of the liquor license from Bocelli's Restaurant to Teixeira Seraphim Inc. for use at the same location. A neighboring resident raised questions regarding potential bar expansion, and the commission noted that any future layout changes would require a separate alteration of premises hearing.

items.title: All-Alcohol License: Great American Beer Hall
items.summary: Granted conditional approval for an all-alcohol license for the project, subject to final ABCC recommendations and sign-offs from pertinent city departments as construction progresses. A neighboring resident voiced concerns regarding historical property maintenance and cleanliness issues at the site.
